scope_checked: source-verified canonical EISEI1-Q-000001 through EISEI1-Q-000016 and all persisted Eisei1 candidates through B10

decisions.rationale: The revised stem uses the exact Article 7(1)(5)(i) condition of more than one thousand workers. B is the sole option matching the at-least-one exclusive hygiene-manager requirement and is distinct from all existing Eisei1 questions.

Article 17(2) directly fixes the annual periodic self-inspection cycle for the scoped dust-control equipment. The distractors are nearby occupational-health intervals and no existing item tests this frequency.

The revised stem is limited to first-category oxygen-deficiency work and preserves the two alternative qualifying courses in Article 11(1). It does not duplicate the existing measurement or ventilation questions.
The revised candidate correctly removes an unsupported request requirement. Article 64-3(1) directly prohibits the listed harmful work for pregnant women and women within one year postpartum.
The MHLW explanation expressly lists inhalation, oral and dermal intake. The alternatives are not intake routes, and the item adds a distinct exposure-route reasoning path.

The current MHLW guideline directly sets a six-month periodic equivalent-noise-level measurement for Table 1 workplaces and separately requires measurement on change. The stem preserves both conditions.
